principles: migration must be previewable before mutation
legacy data must be backed up before removal
runtime logs should live under .koala not docs
human docs under docs/story must never be deleted implicitly
drivers: existing command already owns story storage migration
old projects may have target activity logs already
users need one simple migration command for all Koala machine state

options.name: A: extend story_migrate_storage to include activity migration
pros: single migration command for old projects
keeps story and activity migration atomic from user perspective
cons: story_migrate_storage becomes broader than only story artifacts

options.name: C: silently migrate activity on next write
cons: harder to audit and backup explicitly

chosen: A: extend story_migrate_storage to include activity migration
rationale: 选择 A，因为用户目标是一次性把 Koala 机器状态移出 docs；现有命令已经有 dry-run/confirm/backup 语义，扩展它最少增加认知负担。

preMortem.trigger: 迁移时直接 rename legacy 到 .koala/activity.jsonl
preMortem.mitigation: 如果 target 存在则 append legacy 内容，必要时补换行

preMortem.scenario: 误删 docs/story 人类文档
preMortem.mitigation: 只删除空目录；非空 docs/story 保留并在输出中说明

preMortem.trigger: 为了算 backup 先创建目录或移动文件
preMortem.consequence: 用户预览也弄脏工作区
preMortem.mitigation: dry-run 只读 exists/list，不 mkdir、不写文件
